{{Short description|Trio of players in FC Barcelona}}
{{Italic title|string=MSN}}
{{Use British English|date=September 2026}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=September 2026}}

[[File:Barcelona fans - Champions league 2015 Berlin.JPG|thumb|Barcelona fans holding placards of the ''MSN'' trio ahead of the [[2015 UEFA Champions League final]] in Berlin, Germany. In order: Suarez, Neymar, Messi.]]
'''''MSN''''' (an [[acronym]] for ''Messi'', ''Suárez'' and ''Neymar'') was the attacking trio of [[association football]] players [[Lionel Messi]], [[Luis Suárez (Uruguayan footballer)|Luis Suárez]], and [[Neymar]], who played together for the Spanish club [[FC Barcelona]] for three seasons during 2014–2017<ref name=":7">{{Cite web |last=Revilla |first=David |last2=Roche |first2=Calum |date=15 December 2023 |title=“Messi and I told Neymar that it was a mistake to go to PSG” |url=https://en.as.com/soccer/messi-and-i-told-neymar-that-it-was-a-mistake-to-go-to-psg-n/ |access-date=26 July 2026 |website=AS USA |language=en-us |archive-date=26 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260726221802/https://en.as.com/soccer/messi-and-i-told-neymar-that-it-was-a-mistake-to-go-to-psg-n/ |url-status=live }}</ref> following Suárez's arrival from [[Liverpool F.C.]] in the summer of 2014.<ref>{{Cite news |date=11 July 2014 |title=Luis Suarez: Liverpool & Barcelona agree £75m deal for striker |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/28180600 |access-date=24 July 2026 |work=BBC Sport |language=en-GB |archive-date=22 January 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160122141212/http://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/football/28180600 |url-status=live }}</ref> During their three seasons together, they scored 364 goals and provided 174 assists<ref>{{Cite news |date=8 August 2021 |title=Lionel Messi: Would he give PSG football's best front three - and where would they rank in 21st-century attacking trios? |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/58128764 |access-date=24 July 2026 |work=BBC Sport |language=en-GB |archive-date=24 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260724185420/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/58128764 |url-status=live }}</ref> while helping Barcelona win nine trophies,<ref name=":8">{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=27 March 2025 |title=Neymar shares MSN trio sketch, recalls Champions League victory 🥹 |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/article/neymar-shares-msn-trio-sketch-200900872.html |access-date=27 July 2026 |website=Yahoo Sports |language=en-US |archive-date=6 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251206152805/https://sports.yahoo.com/article/neymar-shares-msn-trio-sketch-200900872.html |url-status=live }}</ref> including the [[continental treble]] in [[2014–15 FC Barcelona season|2014–15]].<ref name=":8" />

With Messi in the right wing position, Suárez in the middle, and Neymar in the left wing position, the trio were able to create a "symbiotic" relationship<ref>{{Cite web |last=Lane |first=Barnaby |last2=Cavani |last3= |first3= |date=6 February 2018 |title=Ranked! The 10 best attacking trios of the 21st century |url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/ranked-10-best-attacking-trios-21st-century |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=FourFourTwo |language=en |archive-date=24 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260724185418/https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/ranked-10-best-attacking-trios-21st-century |url-status=live }}</ref> in which Suárez was a relentless runner, Messi was at the centre of orchestration and team play,<ref name=":9">{{Cite news |last=Ronay |first=Barney |date=4 December 2015 |title=Lionel Messi, Luis Suárez and Neymar bring light to football's darkness |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/blog/2015/dec/04/lionel-messi-luis-suarez-neymar-barcelona |access-date=26 July 2026 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}}</ref> and Neymar was an explosive and creative threat.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Neymar starting to assume leading role at Barcelona |url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/story/_/id/37432096/neymar-starting-assume-leading-role-barcelona |access-date=27 July 2026 |website=www.espn.co.uk}}</ref> In 2015, French sports newspaper ''[[L'Équipe]]'' ranked Messi, Neymar and Suárez as the three best players in the world in a ranking of 100 players, placing them first, second and third, respectively.<ref name=":60">{{Cite web |title=Leo Messi, Neymar Jr and Luis Suárez are top 3 players, according to l'Equipe |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/1072964/leo-messi-neymar-jr-and-luis-suarez-are-top-players-according-to-lequipe |access-date=26 July 2026 |website=www.fcbarcelona.com |language=en |archive-date=26 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260726220213/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/1072964/leo-messi-neymar-jr-and-luis-suarez-are-top-players-according-to-lequipe |url-status=live }}</ref>

The success and popularity of ''MSN'' also popularised the use of acronyms to describe other attacking trios in Europe. They were frequently compared with their [[El Clásico|rivals]] Spanish club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]]'s "'''''BBC'''''" ([[Gareth Bale]], [[Karim Benzema]] and [[Cristiano Ronaldo]]).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Football |first=Planet |date=30 July 2022 |title=Comparing the records of the 'MSN', 'BBC' and 'MNM' front threes |url=https://www.planetfootball.com/quick-reads/comparing-the-records-of-neymar-at-barcelona-and-psg-ronaldo-messi |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=Planet Football |language=en |archive-date=24 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260724185417/https://www.planetfootball.com/quick-reads/comparing-the-records-of-neymar-at-barcelona-and-psg-ronaldo-messi |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Background ==
[[File:Messi with Neymar Junior the Future of Brazil.jpg|thumb|[[Lionel Messi]] and [[Neymar]] after the [[2011 FIFA Club World Cup final]], before becoming future teammates at [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]]. ]]
Prior to the formation of ''MSN'', Messi had achieved unprecedented feats in football,<ref>{{:cite news |date=21 March 2012 |title=Lionel Messi as Dominant as Michael Jordan, Claims Barcelona's Pep Guardiola, After He Breaks Goal Record |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/players/lionel-messi/9157192/Lionel-Messi-as-dominant-as-Michael-Jordan-claims-Barcelonas-Pep-Guardiola-after-he-breaks-goal-record.html |url-access=subscription |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20220110/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/players/lionel-messi/9157192/Lionel-Messi-as-dominant-as-Michael-Jordan-claims-Barcelonas-Pep-Guardiola-after-he-breaks-goal-record.html |archive-date=10 January 2022 |access-date=30 July 2015 |newspaper=The Daily Telegraph}}{{cbignore}}</ref> which included winning four [[Ballon d'Or]] awards consecutively from 2009 to 2012.<ref name="MostDecorated">{{cite news |last=Mohamed |first=Majid |date=8 January 2013 |title=Barcelona's Lionel Messi Becomes Most Decorated Player in History after Winning Unprecedented Fourth Straight Ballon d'Or |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/news-and-comment/barcelonas-lionel-messi-becomes-most-decorated-player-in-history-after-winning-unprecedented-fourth-8441605.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20220614/https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/news-and-comment/barcelonas-lionel-messi-becomes-most-decorated-player-in-history-after-winning-unprecedented-fourth-8441605.html |archive-date=14 June 2022 |access-date=9 August 2015 |newspaper=The Independent}}</ref> Neymar joined Barcelona from his boyhood Brazilian club [[Santos FC]] in 2013 after emerging as one of the most sought-after young players in the world.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Duff |first=Alex |last2=Panja |first2=Tariq |date=30 March 2017 |title=Race for Neymar: the inside story of how Barcelona sealed the controversial deal |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/blog/2017/mar/30/neymar-brazil-barcelona-santos-transfer |access-date=26 July 2026 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}}</ref> During his debut season at Barcelona, he failed to replicate the form he had at Santos.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Pettigrove |first=Jason |date=22 June 2015 |title=Comparing Neymar's 2013/14 Stats with His 2014/15 Numbers for Barcelona |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2500859-comparing-neymars-201314-stats-with-his-201415-numbers-for-barcelona |access-date=27 July 2026 |website=Bleacher Report |archive-date=14 December 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171214044140/http://bleacherreport.com/articles/2500859-comparing-neymars-201314-stats-with-his-201415-numbers-for-barcelona |url-status=live }}</ref> Suárez signed from Liverpool in July 2014 for a reported fee of around €81 million<ref name=":0">{{cite web |date=11 July 2014 |title=Suárez joins Barça. |url=http://www.fcbarcelona.com/football/first-team/detail/article/fc-barcelona-and-liverpool-fc-have-reached-an-agreement-for-the-transfer-of-luis-suarez |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140712034551/http://www.fcbarcelona.com/football/first-team/detail/article/fc-barcelona-and-liverpool-fc-have-reached-an-agreement-for-the-transfer-of-luis-suarez |archive-date=12 July 2014 |access-date=30 July 2014 |publisher=FCBarcelona.com}}</ref> after scoring 31 goals in the [[2013–14 Premier League]] season.<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 May 2014 |title=Infographic: Luis Suarez's 2013-14 records |url=https://legacy.liverpoolfc.com/news/first-team/162838-infographic-luis-suarez-s-2013-14-records |access-date=26 July 2026 |website=Liverpool FC |archive-date=26 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260726174105/https://legacy.liverpoolfc.com/news/first-team/162838-infographic-luis-suarez-s-2013-14-records |url-status=live }}</ref> He was regarded as the best striker in the [[Premier League]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Taylor |first=Louise |date=5 December 2013 |title=Luis Suaréz's sheer creativity makes him the most potent striker in England |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/blog/2013/dec/05/liverpool-luis-suarez |access-date=26 July 2026 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}}</ref>

The trio first started together on 25 October 2014 in the first ''[[El Clásico]]'' of the [[2014–15 FC Barcelona season|2014–15 season]] against Real Madrid at the [[Bernabéu (stadium)|Bernabéu]] stadium, which was the debut of Suárez (he was ineligible to make his debut earlier owing to a [[FIFA]] suspension),<ref>{{Cite news |date=26 June 2014 |title=Luis Suarez bite: Uruguay striker banned for four months |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/28023882 |access-date=26 July 2026 |work=BBC Sport |language=en-GB |archive-date=26 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260726211642/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/28023882 |url-status=live }}</ref> though Barcelona lost 3–1.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Real Madrid spoil Luis Suarez debut as Barcelona fall to defeat |url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/report/_/gameId/402541 |access-date=26 July 2026 |website=www.espn.co.uk |archive-date=8 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210808132451/https://www.espn.co.uk/football/report/_/gameId/402541 |url-status=live }}</ref>

By February 2015, the media had noted a shift in Barcelona's style of play under new manager [[Luis Enrique]], particularly through his use of the attacking trio of Messi, Suárez and Neymar.<ref name=":11">{{Cite news |date=23 February 2015 |title=Luis Suarez shines as Barcelona provider for Lionel Messi & Neymar |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/31575448 |access-date=29 July 2026 |work=BBC Sport |language=en-GB |archive-date=29 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260729154808/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/31575448 |url-status=live }}</ref> While Barcelona previously played under the traditional [[tiki-taka]] philosophy, the team had now adopted a more direct approach, relying mostly on the trio's individual quality in attack.<ref name=":11" /> Suárez's dynamic movement would create space for Messi and Neymar "to cut inside from the wings and wreak havoc."<ref name=":11" />

== Impact ==
After a disappointing [[2013–14 FC Barcelona season|2013–14 season]] for Barcelona,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Pettigrove |first=Jason |date=19 May 2014 |title=Power Ranking Every Barcelona Player from the |archive-date=27 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260727130913/https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2065960-power-ranking-every-barcelona-player-from-the-201314-la-liga-season seven |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11946/9872086/treble-winners-barcelonas-2015-team-emulate-the-super-seven |access-date=27 July 2026 |website=Sky Sports |archive-date=27 July 2026 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=6 June 2020 |title=Rakitic: Barcelona's MSN Era "Was A Joy" |url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/la-liga/articles-video/rakitic-barcelonas-msn-era-was-a-joy |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260727022155/https://sports.yahoo.com/former-barcelona-midfielder-makes-huge-145600471.html |url-status=live }}</ref> By the end of 2014–15, ''MSN'' had proved to be pivotal to Barcelona completing the continental treble,<ref>{{Cite web |date=29 April 2015 |title=Record-setting 'MSN' firing Barca's treble charge |website=OneFootball |language=en |archive-date=24 July 2026 |url=https://www.goal.com/en-gb/lists/msn-reunited-inter-miami-sensational-swoop-sign-neymar-revive-barcelona-trio-lionel-messi-luis-suarez/bltc83aa09f6bff6560 |access-date=26 July 2026 just how pivotal they are to the team's success."<ref>{{Cite web |last=Matchett |first=Karl |title=Where Do Messi, Suarez, Neymar Feature Among Europe's Most Productive Attackers? |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2692113-where-do-messi-suarez-neymar-feature-among-europes-most-productive-attacker |access-date=26 July 2026 |website=bleacherreport.com |language=en |archive-date=26 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260726202623/https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2692113-where-do-messi-suarez-neymar-feature-among-europes-most-productive-attacker |url-status=live }}</ref> Following the Champions League fixture between Barcelona and English club [[Arsenal F.C.]] in 2016, their manager [[Arsène Wenger]] said: "We played against a team with the three best strikers I've ever seen [...] They can create a chance out of nothing."<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |last=UEFA.com |date=17 March 2016 |title=Neymar, Suárez and Messi's fresh masterpiece {{!}} UEFA Champions League 2015/16 |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/022b-0e93b536a271-4b664efef60d-1000--neymar-suarez-and-messi-s-fresh-masterpiece/ |access-date=26 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260517143830/https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/022b-0e93b536a271-4b664efef60d-1000--neymar-suarez-and-messi-s-fresh-masterpiece/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

The chemistry and unselfish play of ''MSN'' led some to consider them as the greatest attacking trio football has ever seen.<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=Verifying Device |url=https://www.thetimes.com/travel/destinations/europe-travel/spain/barcelona/are-msn-the-best-strikeforce-in-football-history-times-writers-have-their-say-7ggzfzmjm?eafs_enabled=false |access-date=26 July 2026 |website=www.thetimes.com |archive-date=26 July 2026 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=history |first=David Villa has described Barcelona's forward line of Lionel Messi, Luis Suarez and Neymar as the best in the club's |title=Villa: MSN the best Barcelona attack in history |url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-mena/football/la-liga/articles/villa-msn-the-best-barcelona-attack-in-hist-1 |access-date=26 July 2026 |website=beIN SPORTS Barcelona captain [[Andrés Iniesta]], who had previously played alongside the formidable attacking trio of Lionel Messi, [[Samuel Eto'o]] and [[Thierry Henry]] that helped Barcelona win the continental treble in [[2008–09 FC Barcelona season|2008–09]], described ''MSN'' as the superior partnership, calling Messi, Suárez and Neymar "the three best players I've ever seen".<ref>{{Cite web |last=ever |first=Lionel Messi, Luis Suarez and Neymar continue to run riot in La Liga, and Andres Iniesta says Barcelona's 'MSN' are the best |title=Barcelona's MSN The Best I've Ever Seen Declares Andres Iniesta |url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/la-liga/articles/barcelonas-msn-the-best-ive-ever-seen-declare |access-date=29 July 2026 |website=beIN SPORTS |language=en-us |archive-date=29 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260729154029/https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/la-liga/articles/barcelonas-msn-the-best-ive-ever-seen-declare |url-status=live }}</ref> ''MSN''<nowiki/>'s willingness to share goalscoring opportunities drew praise.<ref>{{Cite news |date=17 March 2016 |title=Messi, Suarez & Neymar - the Barcelona Grand Masters |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/35830643 |access-date=26 July 2026 |work=BBC Sport |language=en-GB |archive-date=27 July 2026 to their selflessness and lack of ego considering that Messi was previously the "main star" at Barcelona, a position that Suárez was also used to when he was at Liverpool.<ref name=":5">{{Cite web |last=Barcelona |first=Gerard Pique has stressed Lionel Messi, Luis Suarez and Neymar's generosity towards each other has been key to their success at |title=Barcelona Trio Lionel Messi, Luis Suarez Following Neymar's departure to PSG in 2017,<ref>{{Cite news |last=Laurens |first=Julien |date=4 August 2017 |title=Neymar: how the record-breaking €222m move to PSG unfolded |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2017/aug/04/neymar-how-record-breaking-move-to-psg-unfolded |access-date=26 July 2026 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077 |archive-date=4 August 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170804182813/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2017/aug/04/neymar-how-record-breaking-move-to-psg-unfolded |url-status=live }}</ref> Barcelona struggled to emulate the level of attacking threat that ''MSN'' produced.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ranking all 42 Barcelona signings since Neymar left Camp Nou |url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/story/_/id/37977914/ranking-all-42-barcelona-signings-neymar-left-camp-nou |access-date=26 July 2026 |website=www.espn.co.uk |archive-date=27 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260727110512/https://www.espn.co.uk/football/story/_/id/37977914/ranking-all-42-barcelona-signings-neymar-left-camp-nou |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=20 June 2019 |title=Neymar never replaced by Dembélé and Coutinho |url=https://en.as.com/en/2019/06/20/soccer/1561035391_649102.html |website=[[Diario AS]] |access-date=27 July 2026 |archive-date=27 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260727154156/https://en.as.com/en/2019/06/20/soccer/1561035391_649102.html |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=13 April 2018 |title=Barca coach tells players to forget Roma collapse |url=https://www.france24.com/en/20180413-barca-coach-tells-players-forget-roma-collapse |website=[[France 24]] |access-date=27 July 2026 |archive-date=23 August 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250823233522/https://www.france24.com/en/20180413-barca-coach-tells-players-forget-roma-collapse |url-status=live }}</ref>
